verdict.rationale: Bugbot runs automatically in the background on every PR and PR update, reviewing for bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality. The docs explicitly pair it with Cursor's Cloud Agents, which open PRs that Bugbot then reviews. That covers the core of verifying agent-authored code at scale without human bottlenecks, and community users report it finds genuine bugs, though one hands-on user saw it flip-flop between recommendations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated-PR-specific verification or throughput/volume figures, and independent evidence of reliability on agent-authored code at scale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the reviewer holds the line on AI-generated PRs — it verifies agent-authored code at a volume no human team could review

citations.quote: Runs automatic reviews on every PR update
Cloud Agents clone your code, work on branches, and open pull requests. Bugbot reviews pull requests and posts its findings as comments.
It analyzes every pull request for bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues, leaving inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes.
When enabled, Bugbot automatically runs AI code review in the background on new PRs.
it finds genuine bugs most reviewers miss
